Hi Diego —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Happy to share more so you can tailor the demo: 

Use case: Real-time summarization and TL;DR generation for customer support ticket streams; secondarily long-form doc summarization for internal knowledge.
Volume: We’re currently ingesting ~30M tokens/month across production and pilot users; we expect this to grow to ~120M tokens/month in 3–6 months if pilot converts.
Timeline: We’re trying to run a pilot in April and decide on a production rollout by June.

I attached a short requirements doc with some sample inputs and latency targets: briefly_requirements.docx

For timing, the Tue 3/23 09:00 PT slot works for me. Please send an invite to samira@briefly.ai and ops@briefly.ai.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing the latency/cost demos.

—Samira
